purpose: Separate an actual deployed-image comparison from validation of OCI-to-Docker size accounting.

collect: Storage driver and image store (classic graphdriver vs containerd)
Descriptor (target manifest/index) when exposed by Docker version
existing_image_read_only.do_not_dump: Do not dump Config.Env, daemon credentials or unreviewed full image history; historical build args may contain private index credentials.

same_artifact_method_validation.required: The exact OCI archive must be available in an approved disposable Docker image store with adequate disk. Preserve config digest and ordered diff_ids when importing or converting to Docker archive.
identity_checks: Classic graphdriver: Docker image ID equals OCI config digest
Containerd: image ID/Descriptor digest identifies its target index or manifest; verify selected manifest against the OCI manifest, not automatically against config digest
Ordered RootFS.Layers equals OCI config rootfs.diff_ids
Same linux/amd64 platform and revision label
same_artifact_method_validation.accounting: Compare actual Docker inspect.Size bytes with the matching store model for the exact artifact: cumulative unpacked hdr.Size for classic graphdriver, or packed descriptor graph sizes for containerd. Keep compressed layer sums and whole tar bytes separate.
same_artifact_method_validation.current_environment_limit: No application OCI archive loaded into the vfs daemon; cumulative vfs copies can require much more disk than a layer payload sum.
same_artifact_method_validation.existing_calibration: Four pinned base layers matched actual local Docker inspect.Size exactly at119181182 bytes. This validates that base, not a full application inspect.

interpretation: A freshly rebuilt ad10 source image is not evidence of what is currently deployed.
A different deployed config ID or layer sequence means different artifact inputs, not automatically a measurement error.
If identical artifact IDs/diff_ids produce a different Size, investigate image-store accounting and Docker version directly.
A large historical rebuild under identical current options does not by itself establish an incorrect OCI method.

docker_v28_accounting_by_store.classic_graphdriver: Sum unpacked tar header payload Size over cumulative layers (Moby UnpackLayer -> ApplyDiff -> roLayer.Size).
docker_v28_accounting_by_store.containerd: image_inspect.go uses i.size(): sum of packed resource descriptor Size values. Includes the exact descriptor graph resources, not OCI archive tar padding.
docker_v28_accounting_by_store.containerd_image_id: ImageInspect response ID is target.Digest (manifest/index), unlike classic config-based image ID.

qualified_compressed_layer_limit: These are layer descriptors alone, not a completed actual VM inspect.Size comparison. Do not substitute whole OCI archive size for packed resource accounting.
